exam_exercises.text: Part 1 — Multiple Choice (۲۰ نمره — هر سؤال ۲ نمره)

items.question: If you ______ hard, you will become a good artist.
We will buy that carpet if it ______ not too expensive.
If people appreciate art, they ______ protect it.
She was really ______ when she saw the beautiful painting.
This handicraft is very ______. I want to buy it.
If we visit Isfahan, we ______ see amazing tilework.
He felt ______ after finishing his artwork.
If the artist works hard, his art ______ improve.
I am ______ about learning calligraphy this year.
If tourists respect our culture, they ______ enjoy their trip more.

exam_exercises.text: Part 2 — Fill in the Blanks with the Correct Verb Form (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Fill in the Blanks with the Correct Verb Form

items.text: If you ______ (visit) the museum, you will see many handicrafts.
She will ______ (buy) a carpet if she has enough money.
If people ______ (appreciate) art, they will support artists.
I will ______ (feel) happy if I learn calligraphy.
If we practice every day, we will ______ (learn) faster.

exam_exercises.text: Part 3 — Choose the Correct Adjective Form (۱۵ نمره — هر سؤال ۳ نمره)

items.text: I am really (interested/interesting) in Persian handicrafts.
He felt (bored/boring) at the museum because he didn't like art.
We were (surprised/surprising) by the beautiful tilework.
That painting is (excited/exciting) to look at.

exam_exercises.text: Part 4 — Rewrite the Sentences (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۵ نمره)

items.answer: If you study calligraphy, you will become a good artist.
items.task: Combine into a Conditional Type I sentence:
items.text: You study calligraphy. You will become a good artist.

items.answer: If it doesn't rain, we won't stay home.
items.task: Rewrite in the negative if-clause form:
items.text: If it rains, we will stay home.

items.answer: The news made us feel surprised.
items.task: Rewrite using the correct past participle adjective:
items.text: The news made us feel surprise.

exam_exercises.text: Part 5 — Reading and Choosing the Best Word (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Read the paragraph and choose the correct word.
exam_exercises.passage: If you visit/will visit Isfahan, you see/will see many beautiful handicrafts. I am always excited/exciting when I look at Persian art. If people appreciate/will appreciate art, they help/will help artists continue their work. Art can be really interested/interesting for everyone.
